analysis.pricePatternEn: Sideways — Mismatch between 5-day and 20-day high/low patterns
analysis.reason: RSI가 40.2로 중립 구간에 머물고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나 여전히 음수 구간이다. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율이 0.69로 위축되어 있어 현재 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮다.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI remains at 40.2 in neutral territory, and while the MACD histogram is improving, it is still in negative territory. The volume ratio relative to the 5-day average is 0.69, indicating low conviction in the current price action.
analysis.narrative:

[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-3.7781→-2.7813) + 개선 진단 + 여전히 약세 구간이나 반등 가능성 시사
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (중단 $146.84) + 밴드폭 75.51%로 넓은 편
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($116.47) + 근거 (현재가 바로 아래 위치, 20일 저가와 근접)
· 스윙 저항선 ($191.29) + 돌파 시 중기 추세 회복 기대
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (횡보) + 추세 전환 불확실

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($116.71) vs SMA5/20/50 ($109.54/$146.84/$196.18) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating a short-term rebound followed by a decline below mid-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($147.41/$98.93) — Above SMA200, below SMA100, showing mixed long-term trend.
· 52-week position (32.1%) + Current price level is high relative to historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.1→40.2) + Neutral assessment + Attempting to exit oversold territory but weak directional momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.7781→-2.7813) + Improvement assessment + Still in bearish territory but suggesting potential for rebound.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle band $146.84) + Bandwidth is relatively wide at 75.51%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($116.47) + Basis (Immediately below current price, close to 20-day low).
· Swing resistance ($191.29) + Breakthrough expected to signal mid-term trend recovery.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Sideways) + Trend reversal uncertainty.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.69x) + Low conviction in price movement.
· Current phase assessment (Accumulation phase) + Consider entering long on confirmation of $116.47 support.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 52주 저가 대비 32.1% 위치에 있으며, 20일 저가인 $91.50 대비 높은 수준에서 횡보 중이다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is at 32.1% of its 52-week low and is trading sideways at a level significantly above the 20-day low of $91.50.
keyPoints: RSI가 40.2로 중립 구간에 머물며 방향성 부재
MACD 히스토그램은 개선 중이나 여전히 음수 구간

keyPointsEn: RSI at 40.2, indicating a lack of directional momentum in neutral territory.
MACD histogram improving but remains in negative territory.
Volume ratio of 0.69 suggests low conviction in current price action.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 28.0으로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되지 않은 상태에서 변동성이 커질 경우, 추세 전환보다는 충격성 되돌림일 가능성이 높다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 28.0 indicating no clear trend, any significant price swings could be indicative of shock-driven reversals rather than a sustained trend change.
analysis.continuity: 오늘까지 4거래일 연속 관망 판독이 이어지고 있다. 직전 3거래일 동안 RSI는 38.7에서 40.4 사이를 오갔으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되지 않은 채 음수 구간을 유지했다. 금일 RSI는 40.2로 소폭 상승했으나 여전히 중립 구간에 머물고 있으며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되는 모습을 보였으나 여전히 약세 신호다. 따라서 기존 관망 기조를 유지한다.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has now been maintained for 4 consecutive trading sessions. Over the previous three sessions, RSI fluctuated between 38.7 and 40.4, while the MACD histogram remained in negative territory without improvement. Today, RSI has slightly increased to 40.2, still within neutral territory, and the MACD histogram shows improvement but still signals weakness. Therefore, the existing wait-and-see approach is continued.
